description: This file defines the Legacy module for HTMLPurifier, which handles deprecated HTML elements for XHTML 1.1 compliance. It includes class definition, setup of deprecated elements, and their attributes.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_HTMLModule_Legacy
classes.description: A class extending HTMLPurifier_HTMLModule that sets up deprecated HTML elements for XHTML 1.1.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes deprecated HTML elements and their attributes for the legacy module.
